reason: Post-hoc, after scoring and an internal review: Glasgow answered none of the IdCon-HPRD runs. Profiling one task showed ~1.4 s of each Glasgow call spent in its default supplemental-graph preprocessing on the gadget-enlarged target, with 9 search nodes. Glasgow ships a --staged option (cheap filtering first, supplemental graphs only if a bounded first search round fails). A new arm glasgow_staged (identical encoding, --staged) is run on all IdCon-Hard and IdCon-HPRD tasks with the same driver, budget and two repeats. The registered glasgow arm and its records are unchanged and still reported; glasgow_staged is labelled post hoc.
